title: Big black triangle hovers over Vandenberg runway
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Big black triangle hovers over Vandenberg runway, about unspecified at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh Jeff Nusatelli also described you know a big black triangle coming out of the Pacific Ocean flying into Vandenberg

When I arrived on scene, I talked to five shaken witnesses who described a massive triangular craft larger than a football field that hovered silently for about 45 seconds over their entry control point before shooting away at impossible speed.
tellings.difference: Told first-hand, dated October 14, 2003, hovering about 45 seconds over the entry control point (not the runway) with five witnesses, then leaving at great speed.
tellings.link_reason: Nuccetelli's large triangle hovering over Vandenberg is the big black triangle story that Matthew Brown relays from him.

as_told.title: Football-field-sized triangle over entry control point at Vandenberg

plain: Matthew Brown, who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, relays an account from a man named Jeff Nuccetelli. According to Nuccetelli, a big black triangle came in out of the Pacific Ocean and flew into Vandenberg, a military base on the California coast used for missile and space launches, where it hovered over the runway. No date is given; if true, it would mean an unknown craft moved freely over a sensitive base.
